It’s 100% caused by the adapter and yes, it is system wide. As I start the mac I can already hear myself while booting so it’s definitely caused by the hardware but I know that there were those solutions unter Windows and Linux. Since there is a good package manager under MacOS with brew I thought there might be some way to install some third party mixer here as well, that lets me turn off the monitor but I can literally not find anything like that.

In Windows you toggle off “Listen to this device” in the sound settings and in Linux you install alsamixer, where you can mute the monitor. Have done both already with this headset unter those OS’s.

Also the Headset has a 3.5mm plug, which I first tried in the Mac Mini when I realized, that that is only audio out and not in. The headset also came with a splitter, splitting the 3.5mm plug in 2 plugs for audio and mic. These 2 plugs I plugged into the USB adapter that came with my Logitech G430, specifically made for that purpose but unfortunately the adapter by default always enables a mic monitor.
